# Phase 1 Technical Blueprint: Core Foundation & Identity

**Mission:** Establish the foundational architecture, authentication system, RBAC, and basic admin interface for PatrolManager.

**Generated by:** @tech-lead-orchestrator
**Date:** 2026-02-23
**Model:** opus

---

## Mission Analysis

### Objective
Build a secure, scalable foundation for the PatrolManager security guard management system including:
- 4-layer backend architecture (Express.js + PostgreSQL + Sequelize)
- RBAC with 4 roles (Admin, Manager, Supervisor, Guard)
- Hybrid authentication (JWT for mobile, Session for web)
- Basic Admin UI for user/role management
- Complete test coverage and documentation

### Technical Challenges
1. **Architecture Purity**: Enforcing strict layer separation (no Express in services)
2. **Dual Auth Strategy**: JWT and Session must coexist securely
3. **RBAC Complexity**: Four roles with hierarchical permissions
4. **Database Design**: Extensible schema for future phases

### Success Criteria
- All unit tests pass with >80% coverage
- Integration tests verify auth flows
- Security audit shows zero critical/high vulnerabilities
- Code review confirms architecture compliance
- Admin UI allows full user lifecycle management

## Risk Assessment

### Risk 1: Layer Separation Violation
**Severity**: High
**Description**: Developers may accidentally import Express/types into core services
**Mitigation**:
- ESLint rule preventing Express imports in core/
- Architectural review by @code-reviewer
- Clear documentation in CLAUDE.md

### Risk 2: Authentication Security Flaws
**Severity**: Critical
**Description**: JWT or session implementation may have vulnerabilities
**Mitigation**:
- @security-auditor involved in Step 7 (implementation)
- Dedicated security audit in Step 14
- Use industry-standard libraries (Passport.js, bcrypt)

### Risk 3: Database Schema Incompatibility
**Severity**: Medium
**Description**: Schema may not support future phases (geofencing, real-time)
**Mitigation**:
- @database-optimizer reviews full project requirements
- Schema designed with extensibility
- Migration strategy from start

### Risk 4: Insufficient Test Coverage
**Severity**: Medium
**Description**: Tests may not cover edge cases in auth flows
**Mitigation**:
- @test-automator dedicated 12 hours
- Coverage threshold enforced (>80%)
- Integration tests for critical paths

### Risk 5: UI/UX Inconsistency
**Severity**: Low
**Description**: Admin UI may have inconsistent styling
**Mitigation**:
- @ui-ux-designer designs all UI components
- Tailwind CSS ensures consistency
- Component library approach

## Gate 1 Requirements

### Automated Tests (Must Pass)
- [ ] Unit tests: >80% coverage
- [ ] Integration tests: All auth flows pass
- [ ] Security audit: Zero critical/high vulnerabilities
- [ ] Lint check: Zero errors, zero warnings

### Manual Verification (Required)
- [ ] Login to admin panel with Admin credentials
- [ ] Create a user with each role (Manager, Supervisor, Guard)
- [ ] Verify JWT auth works via Postman/curl
- [ ] Verify session management in browser DevTools
- [ ] Test password reset flow
- [ ] Verify role-based permissions work

### Documentation (Required)
- [ ] API docs accessible at /api-docs
- [ ] SETUP.md allows new developer to run project
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md defines code standards

### Success Criteria
```
✅ All tests passing
✅ Security audit clean
✅ Code review approved
✅ Manual verification complete
✅ Documentation complete
```
